01 What we do

Services we offer

From the roofline down, we take on every part of your home's exterior — and we treat each one like it's our own.

R-01

Metal Roofing

Standing-seam metal, shingles and flat-roof systems built to stand up to New Brunswick winters for decades. Our specialty.

S-02

Siding

Clean, durable siding that lifts your curb appeal and seals your home against the elements.

D-03

Decking

Custom decks built to last — the outdoor space your family will actually want to spend time on.

W-04

Windows

Energy-efficient window replacement that improves comfort, cuts drafts and adds value.

DR-05

Doors

Entry, storm and patio doors installed for security, insulation and a strong first impression.

G-06

Garages

Garage builds and exterior finishing that match the quality of everything else we do.

…and anything else to do with the outside of your home. Not sure if we cover it? Just ask.

02 Who we are

A local family,
not a franchise

Jones Elite Roofing & Exteriors Inc. is a family-run business based in Oromocto, New Brunswick. We handle the exterior of your home — metal roofing, siding, decking, windows, doors, garages and more.

We won't do anything to someone's home that we wouldn't do to our own. Every house we work on gets treated as if it were ours, and we don't sacrifice quality for speed or quantity. Our reputation matters to us, and so does the work we leave behind.

If you're a homeowner who wants a project brought to life with as little stress and inconvenience as possible — you're in the right place. That's the whole point of how we work: Do It Right The First Time.
